visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) 0-3s: In an underground parking garage with grey concrete floors and white pillars, a woman with long, straight brown hair, wearing a light pink t-shirt and white shorts, walks away from the camera. She carries two large blue backpacks, one in each hand. Two young children, a boy in a grey shirt and a girl in a white shirt, run ahead of her toward the parked cars. The lighting is bright and industrial. (2) 4-6s: The scene shifts to the interior of a car. The woman is seated in the driver's seat, holding the steering wheel. She has a tired expression and looks out the window. Daylight illuminates the cabin, and blurred urban buildings and traffic are visible through the windshield. (3) 7-8s: Close-ups of the children in the back seat. A young girl with her hair in pigtails sits in a grey booster seat, looking weary. A young boy next to her laughs with his mouth wide open, looking very energetic. The interior of the car is well-lit. (4) 9-14s: The woman stands in a modern bathroom in front of a mirror. She holds a black smartphone and a beige hairbrush. She brushes her messy hair while looking at her reflection with a sigh of exhaustion. The background shows white tiles and bathroom accessories under bright indoor lighting. (5) 15-20s: In a kitchen, the woman opens a silver refrigerator filled with bottles and snacks. She reaches in and pulls out a red and gold liquid pouch. She holds the pouch close to the camera, displaying the m2 logo and Collagen text clearly. (6) 21-30s: The woman tears the top of the red pouch with her hands and drinks the liquid. A montage follows, showing two red boxes and six gold and red pouches of m2 Collagen 3800 Opearl Nest arranged neatly on a white surface. The lighting is soft and flattering. (7) 31-39s: Seated in a living room, the woman wears a white v-neck blouse. She holds the product box and speaks directly to the camera with a friendly smile. The background features a light-colored sofa and colorful paintings on the wall. (8) 40-52s: A close-up shows a dark brown liquid being poured from a red pouch into a clear, double-walled glass. The woman then picks up the glass and drinks from it. Text overlays with checkmarks highlight specific product features like 3800mg. (9) 53-61s: The woman sits on a play mat on the floor of a bright room, surrounded by colorful plastic toys and blocks. Her two children are playing beside her. She smiles at the camera, showing off a clear and glowing complexion as the video concludes.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote m2 Collagen 3800 Opearl Nest by portraying it as an essential, easy-to-use skincare supplement for busy mothers who feel the effects of aging and fatigue after childbirth. It uses relatable daily scenes to build trust and then presents the product as a premium yet accessible health hack.
